en.headline: Japanese artist Yasuhito Kawasaki shows miniature ceramics at Tai Kwun
en.dek: The exhibition of gentle paintings and palm-sized ceramic sculptures runs at Touch Gallery in Block 3 until 28 November.
body: Japanese artist Yasuhito Kawasaki is holding a solo exhibition of miniature ceramics and paintings at Touch Gallery in Tai Kwun, Central.

The organisers said the works, titled around a green time or meadow theme, were inspired by reports of wild bears coming down from the mountains in Japan, reflecting on the balance between people and nature through small, detailed sculptures.

The exhibition opened on 4 November and continues until 28 November. It is open from 11am to 7pm and is closed on Sundays, Mondays and public holidays. Touch Gallery is at Shop 204, 2/F, Block 3, Tai Kwun, 10 Hollywood Road.
The pieces translate the theme into gentle, palm-sized ceramic forms that visitors can examine closely, the gallery said.

zh.headline: 日本藝術家川崎康仁大館觸摸藝廊展出微型陶瓷
zh.dek: 展覽以溫柔繪畫及掌上陶瓷雕塑為主，在大館第三座觸摸藝廊展至十一月二十八日。
body: 日本藝術家川崎康仁正在中環大館的觸摸藝廊舉行微型陶瓷及繪畫個展。
主辦單位表示，作品圍繞綠色時光或草地主題，靈感來自日本野熊下山的報道，透過細緻的小型雕塑反思人與自然的平衡。
展覽於十一月四日開幕，展期至十一月二十八日。開放時間為上午十一時至下午七時，星期日、星期一及公眾假期休息。觸摸藝廊位於大館第三座二樓204號舖，地址為荷李活道10號。
藝廊指，作品把主題轉化為溫柔的掌上陶瓷形態，讓訪客近距離欣賞。
